annotations.phase_0_facts: container.*, headers.fields, part.tree, part.regions, part.gaps, body.preamble_epilogue, decode.chain and body.content_sha256 are what the skeleton walker measures today (six fields: From, To, Subject, Message-ID, MIME-Version, Content-Type)
annotations.phase_1_facts: headers.date: the row's utc is ['unknown', 'headers.no_date'] (a missing date sorts at a named end, never as an epoch); the gap headers.no_date is a Phase 1 id the walker does not emit today, so it rides in gaps.later
annotations.labels_are_typed: every value was read out of the fixture bytes with a hex-editor-style line dump and typed by a model from the RFC and design rules (D2/D9), never copied out of the walker; labels_provenance is spec because a model wrote them, not a person
annotations.span_conventions: a field's raw_span covers its line including the line ending; value_span starts immediately after the colon and keeps the leading space; a part's headers_span includes its closing empty line
annotations.expected_gaps: headers.no_date (Phase 1, in gaps.later); no phase-0 gap
annotations.not_yet_labelled: addresses, encoded words, body views, attachments, statuses, thread edges and TimeEvents
